confidence_interval_method: 5000 bootstrap draws with persona as the resampling unit; percentile 95% interval.
nll_definition: negative log-probability normalized over the four permitted labels
limitations: Question rows are correlated within personas; confidence intervals resample personas.
No model training or judge model is involved.

LongBench v2 subset: the questions whose raw context is at most 32,768 Qwen tokens (data/splits/longbench). Each context is cut into passages of whole lines (at most 150 words and 1,200 characters) presented as user messages in the shared transcript format; most contexts are documents, not conversations.
Each question has its own context, so the question is the bootstrap unit. Question types are LongBench domains.
The text-only model uses Q4_K_M weights on CUDA without CPU offload. Runtime settings are recorded in the protocol. The configured context cap has not been benchmarked for VRAM fit.
Runtime and memory averages combine evaluator invocations. Per-invocation measurements are in runtime_segments; direct server commands are recorded without interpretation in protocol.server_runs.
resource_measurement: Memory averages are the arithmetic mean of per-question averages. Poll about once per second during scoring; requests with no poll use an immediate post-response snapshot. Missing measurements are null and excluded from averages; coverage counts are reported. GPU readings include other processes; RAM is the Qwen model server working set only. Runtime includes native template/tokenization HTTP requests, and all scoring attempts, including recovery restart overhead but excluding initial model startup and post-response memory sampling.

hardware.scope: All model server sessions in the most recent evaluator invocation; per-question aggregate metrics also include resumed predictions.
hardware.gpu_memory_measurement: Device-wide NVIDIA GPU memory, including desktop/other processes. Samples start after each model startup.
hardware.host_memory_measurement: Windows native Qwen server process working set; excludes Python/evaluator RAM.
